title: Dallas Deep Ellum Food & Street Art Tour by Food Tours of America
includes: 8 generous tastings at 4 handpicked Deep Ellum restaurants — enough food for a meal
Guided Deep Ellum experience— discover its music history, Blues Alley, murals and street art
Enjoy a tasting created for the tour at Hawker's first Texas location inside the former Curtain Club
Custom tasting at 1890 Marketplace, plus unlimitied sampling with time to shop
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

This is a walking tour through Deep Ellum and may include sidewalks, curbs, street crossings and periods of standing. If you have accessibility or mobility needs, please contact Food Tours of America before your tour so we can provide additional information about the route and participating venues.

Guests should be comfortable walking approximately 1 mile and standing for portions of the 2.5-hour tour. The experience includes both indoor and outdoor portions, so please dress for the weather and wear comfortable walking shoes.

At least 72 hours’ advance notice is required for dietary accommodations and menu substitutions. Please provide the name of each guest and their specific dietary restriction or food allergy when booking.
Booking within 72 hours? Please provide your dietary needs at the time of booking. We’ll do our best to accommodate last-minute requests, but some substitutions may be limited or unavailable.
All accommodations depend on each restaurant’s capabilities and cannot be guaranteed. Substitutions may differ from the standard tastings, and in some cases, fewer tastings may be available.

Severe or life-threatening food allergies: Our tours visit multiple independent restaurants, and we do not control their kitchens or the potential for cross-contact. For this reason, our tours may not be appropriate for guests with severe or life-threatening food allergies.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Eat your way through Deep Ellum, where legendary music, bold food and street art come together in one distinctly Dallas experience. Enjoy 8 generous tastings at 4 restaurants, with plenty of food for a meal, featuring global flavors and Dallas favorites from Asian street food and Neapolitan-style pizza to creative tacos and more.

Between bites, follow the stories of the musicians who made Deep Ellum a destination. Walk through Blues Alley, discover the venues that gave blues and jazz artists a stage, and explore murals honoring Bessie Smith, Erykah Badu, Stevie Ray Vaughan and Blind Lemon Jefferson, alongside contemporary work by internationally recognized artist Ron English.

Even the restaurants have stories: enjoy your first tasting inside the former Curtain Club, once part of Deep Ellum’s legendary music scene, plus a special Food Tours of America tasting at a local marketplace.

The music, murals and flavors that make Deep Ellum unmistakably Dallas.
